$comment: Configuration for tools/validate-question-bank.mjs. Edit the contact address before running live checks, and keep the allowlist limited to domains you are permitted to fetch lawfully.

fieldSemantics.$comment: Documentation only: the single source of truth for what each measured link field means.
fieldSemantics.source_initial_http_status: HTTP status returned by the originally requested source_url
fieldSemantics.source_final_http_status: HTTP status returned by the final resolved source_final_url
fieldSemantics.source_redirect_count: number of redirects followed from source_url to source_final_url
fieldSemantics.secondary_initial_http_status: HTTP status returned by the requested secondary_source_url
fieldSemantics.secondary_final_http_status: HTTP status returned by the final resolved secondary_final_url
fieldSemantics.secondary_final_url: final canonical secondary URL after redirects
fieldSemantics.secondary_redirect_count: number of redirects followed for the secondary source
fieldSemantics.draftSentinel: unknown_not_observable (status fields and redirect count) or blank (URL fields) when no live validation has run
fieldSemantics.productionEligibility: source_final_http_status = 200 AND source_final_url present AND source_fact_match = pass AND source_access_status in [public_accessible, accessible_with_redirect] AND source_redirect_count <= 3 AND source_last_checked within freshness window. An initial 200 is never evidence on its own.
